Modern architectures favor relative or rotary position embeddings (RoPE), which incorporate relative token distances directly into query-key inner products through rotational complex matrices, enhancing length extrapolation and context handling. [1]

Used extensively in BERT, WordPiece resembles BPE in vocabulary construction but alters the merge criterion. [1] Rather than choosing the most frequent symbol pair, WordPiece merges the pair that maximizes the likelihood of the training data under a unigram language model, favoring pairs whose co-occurrence significantly exceeds what would be expected by random chance.
